Monsoon brings rain, flooding, and home maintenance tips across India

Heavy monsoon rains have impacted several regions in India, with Delhi and Uttar Pradesh experiencing significant downpours, and Mumbai facing critical conditions over the next 48 hours. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued alerts for 23 states. Flooding and waterlogging have been reported in Delhi, Mumbai, Maharashtra, Gujarat, and hilly areas, disrupting traffic and transport services. In Pune, a building collapsed due to a garbage dump slide, trapping 11 people. Amidst the weather, various outlets offered advice on protecting furniture, cars, and homes from rain damage, and on faster clothes drying and monsoon gardening.
